title: eulophia stenochila
intro: Eulophia stenochila, commonly known as the 'Yellow Lily', is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. Eulophia stenochila is also valued for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which aid in wound healing and reducing pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
